Card Q&A.a: No, you can choose not to.
Card Q&A.q: Do I always have to activate this card's effect when I attack?

Card Q&A.a: No. If you can't add cards from your security stack to your hand, you can't activate the effect.
Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's [When Attacking] effect if I have no cards left in my security stack?

Card Q&A.a: No. The effect has [Once Per Turn], so it doesn't activate on any attacks past the first one.
Card Q&A.q: I attack with this Digimon, then activate its [When Attacking] effect to unsuspend it and give 1 of my opponent's Digimon -6000 DP. If I attack again on the same turn, can I give 1 of my opponent's Digimon an additional -6000 DP?

Effect: [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] You may add the top card of your security stack to your hand to unsuspend this Digimon and have 1 of your opponent's Digimon get -6000 DP for the turn.
